title: Raw Optical Glass - Testing of the Resistance to Attack by Aqueous Acidic Solutions at 25C and Classification
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 14258) covers Raw Optical Glass - Testing of the Resistance to Attack by Aqueous Acidic Solutions at 25C and Classification. This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 8424 : 1987 Raw optical glass — Testing of the resistance to attack by aqueous acidic solutions at 25''C and classification', issued by International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the recommendations of the Optical and Mathematical Instruments Sectional Committee (LM 20) and approval of the Light Mechancial Engineering Division Council. This is one of a series of standards relating to optical glass and optical ceramic testing. The standard, besides giving method of test, also contains basic information about the chemical durability of glass tested. The text of the ISO standard has been approved as suitable for publication as Indian Standard without deviations. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
